notes.title: Void Sols | Randomiser & Demo Update
notes.content:
[h3]🎲 RANDOMISER UPDATE! 🎲[/h3]

We’re excited to introduce the Randomiser Update, a brand-new mode designed to breathe fresh chaos into your Void Sols experience! Whether you're a seasoned adventurer or just curious to mix things up, this mode offers endless replayability with unexpected twists around every corner.

[b]Unlocking the Randomiser Update[/b]
To access this mode:
[list][*] Complete the game at least once.
[*] Start a new save, go to the Challenges menu, and select Randomizer.
[/list]
From there, you can customize your experience with a range of settings to create a new adventure tailored to you!

[b]Randomiser Settings[/b]
We have many settings to customize your randomiser experience:

🌱[b]Custom Seed:[/b] If someone finds a particularly crazy seed, share it so others can give it a shot!
👾[b]Random Enemies:[/b] Every enemy has a chance to be randomly transformed into any other enemy from the game
🗡️[b]Random Item Placement:[/b] Flasks, Weapons, and all other equipment are randomly swapped throughout the game
🗝️[b]Random Key Items Placement:[/b] Keys are randomly placed! We worked hard to ensure this doesn’t cause soft-locks, so be sure to check in unlikely places. There may be opportunities for sequence breaking you haven’t found!
📜[b]Randomise Stats on Level Up:[/b] Every time you level up, your stats are randomly assigned out of the points available. Do you risk leveling up and messing with your stats?
⚔️[b]Randomise Starting Weapon:[/b] Who knows what weapon you will start with, it could be any weapon from the entire game!
🏹[b]Randomise Loadout on Level Up:[/b] All your loadout choices are made for you when you rest to level up. Learn to adapt to whatever RNG gives you! Combine this with random stats on level up for an extremely challenging and chaotic time.

Alongside the Randomiser update we’ve also updated the Void Sols Demo and implemented some bug fixes and other balance changes.

[h3]Patch Notes 1.5.3.6[/h3]
[b]New Features[/b]
[list][*]RANDOMISER CHALLENGE
[/*][list][*]Play the game with a variety of settings randomizing your experience and creating new and surprising encounters
[/*][/list][*]Permadeath Option when creating a new save
[/*][list][*]This will permanently delete your save when you die! Use with caution
[/*][/list][*]Recent Items can be viewed in the pause menu to help you remember the last 10 items you picked up
[/*][*]Added Steam Rich Presence![/*][/list][b]Demo Update[/b]
[list][*]Demo will be shortened up to the Warden
[/*][*]Demo progress and achievement progress can be carried across to the main game
[/*][*]Updated the demo to now include all 11 languages that are present in the main game[/*][/list][b]Gameplay Changes[/b]
[list][*]You can no longer dash through breakable walls, you must attack them to pass. Letting players dash through these walls was causing some issues with pathfinding, enemy AI, and encounter design
[/*][*]Made one section of the Apex Castle Town a little easier
[/*][*]Made one section of the Factory a little easier
[/*][*]Final phase of Amalgamate enemy spawn changed[/*][/list][b]Minor Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Sols gained from killing Warden are no longer lost if you quit without resting
[/*][*]You can no longer find flasks in Ranger Challenge (as intended)
[/*][*]Fixed sorting on trapper spears, preventing them from rendering underneath the environment in some places
[/*][*]Ruby Phial description improved
[/*][*]Multiple localisation fixes in many places
[/*][*]Alpha Wolf should no longer be able to dash out of bounds
[/*][*]You should no longer see the “new” indicator if you find a potion ingredient prior to unlocking Potion Mixing

[/*][*]Confessors can now have their movement speed modified (allowing them to be Trapped or slowed by Caltrops)
[/*][*]Fixed an animation bug with Frying Pan
[/*][*]Confirmation modal UI improvements[/*][/list]
[h3]BALANCE CHANGES[/h3]
[b]Primary Weapons[/b][list][*]Scythe Heavy Attack hitbox and visual are more reliable now

[/*][list][*]Original: 1

[list][*]Relic of Redirection no longer reduces Jolt damage from Lightning Talisman triggering Jolt on yourself. It still significantly reduces Jolt damage from enemies. We felt equipping the Relic of Redirection and Lightning Talisman offered a bit too much free damage with very little downside.[/*][/list][b]Enemies[/b]
[list][*]Reduced maximum number of attacks the Alpha Wolf can chain together
[/*][*]Slightly reduced speed of one of the Cultist Harvester’s more difficult attacks

[/*][list][*]Original: 50

Today we're excited to announce that Void Sols is [b]Steam Deck verified[/b]! We've also just rolled out our first major patch, 1.5.2.1. We've added quite a few new features, gameplay changes, community bug fixes, and some more weapon balance changes.

[/*][*]Frying Pan has a new secret synergy…
[/*][*]Equipping items play unique sounds!
[/*][*]All equipment that is picked up should now display a new item icon on the equipment button until hovered over by the player
[/*][/list][h3]Gameplay Changes[/h3][list][*]Parrying Shield now parries whenever you release the button. Previously you could only tap to parry, meaning holding it did nothing. You can still tap to parry as before, but now you can also hold to ready the parry and release, allowing a bit more depth to parrying gameplay and not punishing the player for holding the button for a bit too long
[/*][*]Cold Debuff: This was previously dealing entirely too much damage to enemies. We have enough damage-dealing status effects, so we decided to rework this status effect into something that has a different kind of utility. Triggering cold on yourself has been unchanged, you still take a chunk of non-fatal damage, and have your stamina regeneration reduced. If an enemy is affected by cold however, they take stance damage, reduced move speed, and their stance will no longer regenerate until the status depletes.

notes.title: Void Sols Patch 1.5.1.4
notes.content:
Hello Triangles!

We've just rolled out a new patch, 1.5.1.4. This patch focuses on a few community bug fixes, a new accessibility feature and some balance changes. 

Full patch notes, see below:

[b]New Features[/b][list][*]Added a setting called “Disable Distortion Effects” that allows you to turn off the Mysterious Mushroom screen effect and other effects that can make the screen “wobbly”


[/*][/list][b]Critical Error Fixes[/b][list][*]Nox Gamma would heal enemies that are dead, causing a variety of enemy AI errors
[/*][*]Talisman audio no longer persists if you are using it when you die
[/*][*]Chewy Seaweed, Quiver of Holding, Verdant Berry, Purifying Needle, Stale Bread now all consume a use on press instead of on release
[/*][*]Inserted more safeguards to prevent rare crash when pressing “Die Immediately”
[/*][*]Immaculate can no longer die during its phase 2 transition, causing the player to get stuck and preventing phase 2 from ever happening

[/*][/list][b]Minor Bug Fixes[/b][list][*]Nox Alpha no longer accidentally buffs potions. The text still says it reduces potion effectiveness, but we have removed the buff without implementing the described debuff. We will update the text at a later date to remove the line about potions.
[/*][*]Garnet Aegis no longer accidentally buffing potion heal amount
[/*][*]Zenith move speed reset on stun, preventing inadvertent fast movement if stunned mid-attack
[/*][*]Fixing Spanish Latam metamorphic alloy / sol alembic localization error
[/*][*]Ensuring groundskeeper doesn’t cancel attacks when a confessor is killed
[/*][*]Preventing players from accidentally launching unimplemented Nox Trials due to a UI issue
[/*][*]Fixed enemy pathing issues in mines
[/*][*]The item pickup visible on the beach from the mountain disappears if you have picked up the item on the beach

[/*][/list][b]Balance Changes[/b][list][*]Reduced tracking on Brute Club & Dagger attack combo
[/*][*]Executing Weapon Perk
[/*][list][*]Original: If health < 30%, damage increased by 50%
[/*][*]Updated: if health < 25% then damage increased by 50% else if health < 50% then damage increased by 25%
[/*][/list][*]Assassinating Weapon Perk
[/*][list][*]Original: if health > 70% increase damage by 50%
[/*][*]Updated: if health > 75% increase damage by 25%
[/*][/list][*]Flame Talisman Player Burn Buildup
[/*][list][*]Original: 15
[/*][*]Updated: 20
[/*][/list][*]Blizzard Talisman Player Cold Buildup
[/*][list][*]Original: 15
[/*][*]Updated: 20
[/*][/list][/list]

Make sure to update your game now!

notes.title: Void Sols Minor Patch 1.5.1.3a
notes.content:
Hello Triangles!

We hope you’ve been having a good time exploring the depths of the Void. Thank you again for all your support on the game and make sure to join the chatter over on our Discord channel!

We've just rolled out a [b]minor patch 1.5.1.3a[/b] to fix a bug that was sometimes causing the game to launch into a black screen. This was occurring mainly for players who had an old supermax challenge save.

If you are experiencing this issue, make sure to update your game now to the latest build!

The team is also currently working on a larger patch that will squash some other bugs, community reported issues and some balance changes to the game. We’re hoping to roll this out very soon, so stay tuned.

As always, thank you for all your bug reports and game feedback!

notes.title: Innovative new 2D soulslike game Void Sols hits full launch on Steam
notes.content:
Everyone wants to be a soulslike, or at least that's how it can feel at times. The big names like FromSoftware keep on hitting new heights with Elden Ring, Bloodborne, and of course the three Dark Souls games. In the background, there's a susurration of soulslikes continually appearing, like Lords of the Fallen, Mortal Shell, Lies of P, and Thymesia. None manage to really hit the same notes as FromSoft, however, with the legendary developer showing a perpetual mastery of the genre. That might be about to change with Void Sols, a new game out now that tries something new in this space.

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
Void Sols is FromSoftware without the third dimension, and it's coming soon
This 2D minimalist soulslike perfectly understands why the genre works
Exciting, unique new indie soulslike game launches free Steam demo

notes.title: Void Sols is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h3]🌌 Void Sols is OUT NOW! 🌌[/h3]

[previewyoutube=9ANyHuFMNcw;full][/previewyoutube]
In [b]Void Sols[/b], you play as a humble Triangle, traversing a stark and unforgiving landscape. The journey isn’t just about survival but rather transformation. Battle through angular enemies, gather Sols to level up, and experiment with a variety of unique builds to shape your character into a formidable force. Hidden passageways and dark corners offer endless surprises, while the mysterious lore of Void Sols unfolds with every encounter.

[h3]🛠 Extensive Buildcrafting Options[/h3]
Void Sols invites you to find the playstyle that suits you best. Experiment with a wide range of weapons, equipment, and upgrades, creating the ultimate version of your Triangle. Whether you prefer agility, power, or balance, there’s a build for every player.

[h3]⚔️ Approachable Yet Challenging Soulslike Combat[/h3]
Perfect for soulslike newcomers and veterans alike, Void Sols combines challenging combat with adjustable difficulty settings. Whether you seek a true test or a lighter exploration, you control your experience.

[h3]🌌 Uncover the Lore and it’s Secrets[/h3]
Explore a world filled with layered mysteries and hidden passageways, where every step reveals pieces of a lost history waiting to be uncovered. 

-

In addition to the [b]Standard edition[/b] of Void Sols, we’ve also made available the [b]Deluxe Edition[/b], which includes the game, a digital artbook, Hero's Journal, and Original Soundtrack. [i](just a note: These are currently only available in English, however more languages will be added soon)[/i]

notes.title: Void Sols | Developer Journal vol. 3
notes.content:
Hello Triangles!

We are excited to share the latest episode of our developer journal! If you missed out on our previous episodes, definitely go back and read them over here:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/ogg/2736690/announcements/detail/4283572335399874868]Episode 1 - Introduction[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2736690/announcements/detail/4602203912326746146]Episode 2 - The Forest[/url]

This time, we’re diving deep into a rugged and mysterious area that is brimming with ominous energy. Welcome to [b]the Mountains[/b], a place filled with towering peaks, treacherous paths, and a host of brand-new enemies just waiting to challenge even the most experienced players. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/b6c966a05179abf0c59e495260c98c47c0db19f9.jpg[/img]
As you emerge from the dense thickets of the Forest, there begins a turning point in your adventure. The world before you is now much larger, and you have the power to decide your fate. This is where your journey truly begins—the moment the world opens up, giving you the choice of which path to take next. 

Whether it was by choice or through destiny, if you’ve stumbled upon the Mountains, be prepared as this area will truly test your survival instincts against nature’s harshest elements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/01076096ea7a260d10822cb1900f365e8d2c53a7.png[/img]

When designing this mountainous region we wanted to create an area that feels grand and intimidating, where nature itself becomes a formidable foe. This challenging environment needs to be navigated carefully, as you focus your attention on how to avoid and manage certain environmental debuffs on top of every other threat that lurks around the corner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/5f8c0e80d9aaddc9d233068a3edd73939bfed29f.png[/img]
[h3]Peaks of Peril
[/h3]With any new region, there’s a new set of adversaries! You’ll come face to face with new angular enemies, each armed with their own distinct move sets and strapped with powerful weapons that will inevitably keep you on your toes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/032366f75c1a3fcd9742a9fc7d03f87032fb08b1.png[/img]
Stamina management will be extremely critical while traversing this region, due to the hostile conditions of the territory you’ll be faced with, in addition to the difficulty of the enemies in this area. However, there is always hope, guided by a humble Flaming Torch which you should have discovered earlier in your travels. This item will become a blessing as you navigate your way through the blistering cold.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/cd49935f360a28a6b6e633928224250da670406f.png[/img]
[h3]Harnessing Power in a Harsh Land[/h3]
You might feel like the world itself is against you. Fierce enemies, dangerous terrain, and relentless weather, it can seem like every step forward is a battle for survival. However, for every brutal challenge you face, there’s also a reward waiting for you to claim it. The deeper you venture, the more powerful tools you'll discover to add to your arsenal and relics that resonate with the region, ultimately turning the tide in your favour. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/48a10ee8def79485474ea52913adc8706f6a1491.png[/img]
[h3]Crafting a World That Feels Alive[/h3]
Our design team has been hard at work making sure the icy mountains are both beautiful to look at and deadly to traverse. We want this area to be a place where every corner holds a new threat, but also a reward for those who are brave enough to explore it fully. The new weapons and items aren't just powerful—they’re designed to feel like natural extensions of the environment, giving you the tools to fight the cold and conquer the unpredictable terrain.

We also wanted to give players a sense of freedom by opening up the world and allowing you to choose your path, creating a more immersive and personalised experience. We believe that every decision should feel meaningful, and each region should offer a unique set of risks with a satisfactory pay off, to make your journey unforgettable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/c58f2596752a6e9831d6e68b292302de7cb63692.png[/img]

We’re extremely excited for you to be able to explore this region fully once Void Sols launches next month, [b]November 12th[/b]! Our demo is also available to play for free, for those of you who haven’t had a chance to dive into the world yet. 

-

Big thank you for tuning in to another chapter of this month’s Developer Journal! Are you looking forward to investigating the Mountains next month? 👀  

Remember to also wishlist Void Sols as this really helps us out, and join us over on the official Void Sols Discord server to chat with us, fellow adventurers, share tips, discuss builds and keep up to date with all news about the game.

notes.title: Void Sols is FromSoftware without the third dimension, and it's coming soon
notes.content:
The soulslike explosion brought on by FromSoftware hasn't always yielded the best results. Dark Souls, Bloodborne, and Elden Ring set the bar high, while not many imitators manage to reach it. There are some neat ideas but the mechanical friction and the world's disregard for the player, both of which are needed to make a soulslike play like its namesake, are often missing or poorly designed. Not in Void Sols, though, as I played the upcoming "top-down minimalist" soulslike earlier this year and came away thoroughly impressed. Now, at long last, we finally have an imminent release date, and an updated demo on the way too.

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
This 2D minimalist soulslike perfectly understands why the genre works

notes.title: Void Sols | Developer Journal vol. 2
notes.content:
Hello Triangles!

It’s time for another Developer Journal! If you missed our last developer update, definitely go back and read it over [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2736690/view/4283572335399874867]here[/url].

Kicking things off this time, we’re going to explore some uncharted territory. Everything we reveal today will be brand new content that not even those who have played the demo will know about. So buckle up and get ready to discover [b]The Forest[/b]. 🌳

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/76c6d1bdd79eb8310c6b17213759864c27e1f97d.jpg[/img]
[i]Trees tower above, their thick canopies weaving together, giving cover to the threats that lurk within. You’ve escaped the Prison, yet you’ve somehow ended up venturing deep into a lush, dense forest. The atmosphere seems serene at a glance, yet the further you go, the once peaceful surroundings now feel charged with an ominous energy. Welcome to the darkest parts of The Forest.[/i]

-

Once you successfully journey through the Prison, your next major destination is going to be the Forest. The air is thick here with the scent of pine and damp earth. Listen closely, you’ll be able to hear the soft rustling of the leaves and gentle breeze moving through the branches. As serene as this place may seem compared to where you were before, it is not the sanctuary you hope it will be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/e859f0771b7e755f0ff79049a487a3311e019ee9.png[/img]
This area is one that will connect you to even more areas of Void Sols. Hear the sound of rushing water? A river cuts through the dense woods, serving as a lifeline to help navigate your journey through the dimly lit paths. The river is narrow and the bridges are well-worn but there are new things to discover here and even more lessons to learn. 

[h3]Formidable Foes[/h3]
Of course with a new area comes more unknown enemies. You’ll find yourself coming face-to-face with various new hostile shapes and forms. 

We want you to fully immerse yourself in the experience of these new opponents, so for now we’ll share some sneaky screenshots to give you a taster of what you can expect.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/8dea31750f178582537e5601b7ba783d8046f232.png[/img]
[i]Warning: the flowers here are not your friend.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/0c4e4edabba88ff30b0cd152f376b2478b93e5ca.png[/img]
Despite these new hurdles, you’ll also have the chance to discover new items along the way. Upon leaving the Prison, you will be able to start experimenting with Usable Items: items with limited uses that always replenish when you rest. Be sure to experiment with these, you never know what might happen if you use these in the right context…  

Is it even an RPG if there is no fishing? Find the nifty little Fishing Rod and then the world truly is your oyster! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/728201194c0ad9adb1bd7949ad7dcb06d347af90.png[/img]
[h3]Level Design[/h3]
Every zone in Void Sols has distinct enemies, layouts, and mechanics. We wanted players to experience a game that would constantly surprise and delight them, and to do so, we took great care to rarely repeat content. Instead of creating a massive world with the same enemies, just with more health, we opted to create a dense and diverse experience full of variety.

Each area created goes through many iterations as we design, refine, and playtest to uncover these spaces that are fun to explore and challenging to overcome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/01ae4cd462912b6e8181a19463f95a62a5781d5b.png[/img]
[i]After the game releases, see if you can figure out what area this was a WIP sketch of![/i]

As we playtest and design spaces, we look at the empty spaces between areas and find secrets to fill them in. Many of the areas you may have previously thought to be empty will have entire zones to discover later in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/ea808fc51ef0759586f00a125993894b940c55df.png[/img]
[i]Pay close attention to the maps you collect, they’ll show you shortcuts and secrets alike![/i]

We can’t wait to see how you navigate the lush environments we have created and how you tackle each of the unique enemies you are bound to encounter in them.

-

That was it for this chapter of this month’s Developer Journal! We hope you enjoyed taking a peek into The Forest and a look into our level design process. In our next instalment we will be diving into even more areas that are currently in development. So definitely stay tuned! 👀

Remember to wishlist Void Sols as this really helps us out, and join the official [url=https://discord.gg/NJutng5WWV]Void Sols Discord server[/url] to chat with fellow adventurers, share tips, discuss builds and keep up to date with all news about the game. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2736690/Void_Sols/

Until next time! 👋

notes.title: Void Sols | Developer Journal vol. 1
notes.content:
Hello Triangles!

Whether you’re a newcomer to the game, or a veteran that has explored the shadow-filled maze since its Prologue days, we warmly welcome you to Void Sols!

We’re super excited to share with you our very first Developer Journal. In these developer journals we will be sharing with you major insights into the development progress of Void Sols, giving you a sneak peek of the areas we are working on and a heads up on upcoming content for full launch.

This month we will be focusing on bringing you an introduction to Void Sols. Perfect for those of you who may have not yet been able to play the demo or have just stumbled upon this game and want to find out more about it.

[b][h2]What is Void Sols?[/h2][/b]
Void Sols is a new indie soulslike developed by Finite Reflection Studios that combines the minimalist visuals of Geometry Wars with the tense combat of Dark Souls. You play as a humble triangle facing off against menacing angular enemies and relentless, challenging bosses.

You will die, but the lesson from each defeat is vital. Defeat enemies, collect their Sols and use them to refine your abilities and enhance your build in this abstract fantasy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/7a3c680ab2735e630b241a09549e5c6aa3367c61.png[/img]

[b][h2]Hit the Ground Running[/h2][/b]
As you begin your journey through Void Sols, the game will introduce you to a whirlwind of weaponry to choose from.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/4051eb03b2a2498b4926aaea2594f17a6e893bc1.png[/img]

You will always start with the [b]Sword[/b]. This particular weapon is reliable and consistent and should carry you through the game decently in each scenario you face. The other weapons you will be able to find along your way are the [b]Dagger[/b], [b]Great Hammer[/b], [b]Throwing Daggers[/b], [b]Shield[/b], and [b]Great Bow[/b]. Almost all of these items can be found within the first 30 minutes of the game, so make sure you’re exploring every nook and cranny!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/dcdcbb29213507ff0a91f21a550d0237c6bdd404.png[/img]

The reasoning behind why we made sure that you had the chance to encounter a range of weaponry early into the game, is so that you would immediately feel the breadth of opportunity when it comes to building variety. While other games would have you start with selecting a class and starting items, it was important to us that we gave you everything you would need to experiment and discover the build that would truly resonate with your playstyle.

Since you can change your stats whenever you want to, EVERY item is valuable! An item found in the Prison at the start of the game can even be viable through to the end game, if utilised correctly. 10 different types of swords that have the same animation, yet slightly different stats were not appealing to us. Therefore, our focus was to make sure we created a game that would have fewer total weapons, but making sure each one felt extremely distinct and amplified different power fantasies of the player.

[b][h2]Power Fantasies[/h2][/b]
Now for the fun part - Let's talk about the build archetypes that are available within the first 30 minutes of starting the game:

[b]Generalist[/b] 
Build: [i]Sword, Shield, Relic of Power, stats evenly distributed[/i]

You like stability and reliability. This build does not excel in any given way, but ensures you are ready for whatever the game has to throw at you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/1cccf234cdf1d2cdfaaa1d210c28b28f524d955f.png[/img]
[b]Tank[/b] 
Build: [i]Great Hammer, Great Bow, Relic of Colossus, high VIT / STR[/i]

Dodging is for losers and people with low health and defence. You hit slow, but can take hits as well. The bow gives you versatility while synergizing with the STR scaling of the Great Hammer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/427294a5d071f411ee533033790a2c358ffc1c6a.png[/img]
[b]Glass Cannon[/b] 
Build: [i]Great Hammer, Shield, Relic of Power, only STR[/i]

You are a parry god. Yes, you can only manage one attack before you’re out of stamina, but that attack will hit like a truck hauling dynamite. You will also probably die in one or two hits but that shouldn’t matter because, again, you’re a parry god.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/dc0ecd58c8a4eff71781cff652f4a6fd687e6ee9.png[/img]
[b]Rogue[/b]
Build: [i]Dagger, Throwing Dagger, Relic of Agility[/i]

You like to keep moving. You don’t like the waiting game, and prefer to be up close and personal when you deliver the killing blow. This playstyle is fast paced, and takes advantage of stunning enemies and bosses through continuous damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/4265550023702ea5bed37f9c86ad32f5d56692cd.png[/img]
The further you get into the game, the more diverse and strange the power fantasies become (there may or may not be a “Pyromaniac” archetype that you can build into by the late game!). Give these builds a try once you get your hands on the game and we look forward to seeing what builds you conjure up as well!

[b][h2]The Enemies[/h2][/b]
The Prison Yard will present you with a range of interesting but aggressive enemies that are sworn to keep you imprisoned. Every enemy in Void Sols is designed to feel distinct from one another with memorable and predictable attack patterns, rewarding cautious observation and combat experimentation. The more you know, the better your odds.

[b]Guard[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/a18b3a9ba98bf0a288dbc051bbafa55cf6dc296c.png[/img]
The [b]Guard[/b] is the first enemy you will encounter once you escape from your prison cell. Their long swords can perform wide, mid-range attacks in an arc pattern. They can be stunned before they attack if you are aggressive enough, just make sure you have enough stamina for anyone else waiting their turn to fight!

[b]Grunt[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/7d40fb8d44a83e1bc39d549f1bcaa6f745615c6f.png[/img]
You will encounter these pentagon shaped enemies known as the [b]Grunt[/b] in dark crevices within the Prison. They are aggressive, fast, and squishy. Though they die in only a few hits, their dagger attack can come faster than you expect!

[b]Jailer[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/1a1a17b2525eb989d1292dc71dac74ea15512115.png[/img]
This intimidating foe is the [b]Jailer[/b], guarding multiple areas of the Prison. Relentless in their pursuit of you, they are the first enemy in the game to introduce a combo attack. It's always the same attack with the exact same timing, however the damage will leave little room for error. 

[b]Spotter[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/d6089792300d4d09f51f6a479149047b4e88f68b.png[/img]
Possessing the ability to perform both short-range and long-range attacks, the [b]Spotter[/b] is sure to be a threat. They utilise their charged arrows to fire attacks into the distance, but if you choose to close the gap, they will bring out their dagger to perform fast, close range attacks.  

[b]Watcher[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/85b962fcbe504749f26c5fbfcab3a30d705a5891.png[/img]
As the name suggests, the Watcher patrols high security areas, alerting enemies of any intruders if they get within their line of sight. This enemy is also special, as you cannot damage them, meaning that avoiding them is the wisest choice.

-

We hope you enjoyed the first chapter of this Developer Journal and we look forward to sharing with you more insights into the world of Void Sols! In our next instalment we will be diving into what lies [b]BEYOND[/b] the Prison. This will all be new content, even for those who have played the demo, so stay tuned! 👀

Remember to wishlist Void Sols before you embark on your next quest, and join the official Void Sols [url=https://discord.gg/NJutng5WWV]Discord[/url] server to chat with fellow adventurers, share tips, discuss builds and keep up to date with all news about the game.

notes.title: This 2D minimalist soulslike perfectly understands why the genre works
notes.content:
Since Dark Souls exploded, adding a whole new chapter to the RPG playbook in 2011, soulslikes have been a dime a dozen. Every man and his dog has taken a swing at the formula - where the game world's friction goes against the player any way it can, with no care for how they'll react - and quite a few games have done a decent job. Lords of the Fallen, Nioh, and Lies of P are just some of the bigger examples. But when we talk about soulslikes, we're almost always looking at them through a lens of third-person action roleplaying games. So what would happen if we removed an entire dimension from the genre: how would it play, and would it even work? This is a question Void Sols wants to answer, and it's the most unique spin on soulslikes I've ever played.

notes.title: Void Sols is an atmospheric and highly customisable Soulslike for people who are rubbish at Soulslikes
notes.content:
You know me and Soulslikes. We're not particularly best buddies most of the time. We've had a couple of successful outings over the years with the likes of Death's Door and Hollow Knight and company, but anything with pure FromSoft blood running through its veins has always left me cold. Void Sols, however, is an upcoming Soulslike that feels like it might be able to satisfy both sides of the 'git gud' camp, appealing to nervous dodge-rollers like myself while also giving hardened Elden Ringers a run for their money. It's all down to its plentiful supply of approachable customisation options, allowing you to ratchet up the difficulty if you're finding things a bit easy, or knock it down, reapply your stat points, and even create whole new loadouts - each with their own individual stat combinations - to win the day. It's all wonderfully considerate, and having played the free demo that's just launched on Steam, I'd strongly recommend giving it a go if you're feeling in need of a little training ahead of Elden Ring: Shadow Of The Erdtree coming out.

notes.title: Exciting, unique new indie soulslike game launches free Steam demo
notes.content:
Of all the games to tread in the wake of Dark Souls and Elden Ring, new indie soulslike game Void Sols might be one of the most distinctive and exciting. Returning to the top-down roots of the Legend of Zelda games that inspired FromSoftware's genre-defining RPGs, this new game infuses the vibrant, minimalist look of Geometry Wars into a challenging action RPG that you have to see for yourself. The good news is that you can go one better and try it, thanks to the launch of a free Steam demo that's available right now.
